parsed.summary: Router r1 is configured with two Ethernet interfaces, eth1 and eth2, serving as a gateway for the client segment (eth1) and providing a link to another router, r2 (eth2). It performs IP forwarding and has static routes configured to reach far-side segments via r2. Additionally, there are firewall rules in place to drop traffic from the 10.0.1.0/24 network destined for the 10.0.99.0/24 network.

static_routes.purpose: Reach the far-side segment via r2
Reach another far-side segment via r2

access_rules.purpose: Drop traffic from client segment destined for another far-side segment
